content: Professional continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems offer retrospective glucose data, which is instrumental in identifying patterns of hypoglycemia and hyperglycemia. This is particularly advantageous in situations where intermittent scanning CGM (isCGM) or real-time CGM (rtCGM) devices are not available. These systems enable healthcare providers to refine and optimize treatment strategies by analyzing glucose trends over a specific period. Professional CGM devices do not require calibration, which enhances their ease of use. This feature makes them especially suitable for intermittent use in individuals who may not require or benefit from continuous CGM monitoring.
